scenarios.title: Publication rejects stale independent review
given: Draft revision 7 approved with digest A.
when: Attempt publish with revision 7 and digest A.

scenarios.title: Duplicate creates independent learning occurrences
given: Parent has lessons A and B. A has one resource R.
when: Move its copy ahead of A.
then: Copy and copied child receive two new keys.
Original and copy share allowed resource revision and retain independent progress.

scenarios.title: Three-way propagation preserves local text
given: Base core text A and no note.
Source changes core to B. Target adds note N.
then: Core B and note N appear.
Publication remains at prior version until separately approved.

scenarios.title: Protected concurrent edits require a decision
given: Same protected path has values A, B and C in baseline, source and destination.
then: One unresolved conflict, no draft change.

scenarios.title: Type mismatch stays quarantined
then: State rejected and no approved rendition or learner URL.

scenarios.title: Durable publication retry returns same version
given: Manifest and database transaction committed but client timed out.
then: Original course version ID and digest returned, one published event.

scenarios.title: Unresolvable prerequisite blocks publication
given: A requires B completed. B requires A completed.
then: Report OUTLINE_DEPENDENCY_CYCLE with both affected stable keys.

scenarios.title: Preview never creates an attempt
when: Start simulated learner preview and operate exam controls.
then: UI is explicitly a preview. No official attempt or progress record.

scenarios.title: Catalog code normalization and metadata compare-and-swap
given: Unit M is in institution S. Existing catalog code ALG.
when: Create ALG-2, update its title from Algebra II to Intermediate Algebra at revision 1, try stale update at revision 1, and archive at revision 2.
Try to create alg under the same institution.
then: ALG-2 revisions 1, 2 and 3 are visible to authorized staff. Stale update fails. Case-folded ALG collision returns 409 COURSE_CODE_EXISTS.

scenarios.title: Publish independent reviewed draft and read exact manifest
given: A course has no prior version, a reviewer separate from its author and a published assessment definition.
when: Create blank draft, create lesson definition and quiz activity, then seal edits and an acknowledgment rule.
Insert exact versions, validate, submit digest and receive independent approval. Publish then read the exact manifest.
Archive the publication with active uses acknowledged.
then: Version 1 reflects the approved content and exact assessment binding. Archived version retains readable authorized manifest and cannot be selected as new default.

scenarios.title: Author withdraws an abandoned fork
given: Course has publication version 2 and active learners.
when: Fork a draft from version 2, then abandon it with reason obsolete proposal.
then: Fork has matching stable placement keys. Abandon changes only the fork and leaves version 2 and learner records intact.

scenarios.title: Library linked adoption and independent detachment
given: Institution S licenses its fractions explainer for independent copy within S.
when: Create library STEM. Publish FRACTIONS revision 1. Adopt linked into lesson L and detach after correcting attribution.
then: The independent definition receives a new logical identity. Provenance retains source revision 1 and linked updates no longer target the detached placement.

scenarios.title: Asset permission and emergency withdrawal lifecycle
given: A 4096-byte approved media upload belongs to a shared lesson. The exact digest is later identified as compromised.
when: Allocate one-use upload, receive and scan exact bytes, publish a reference, then withdraw under authorized reason.
then: Quarantined bytes are inaccessible until approval. Withdrawal denies subsequent authorized delivery while immutable published references and source evidence survive.

scenarios.title: Hosted media requires a pinned provider revision
given: A teacher has an approved institutional media connection and rights to media key video-11.
when: Reserve hosted asset. Try approval when provider reports a moving latest alias. Resolve provider version media-v2-20261110 and retry through the authorized map.
then: Alias fails REMOTE_ASSET_UNPINNED. Immutable provider revision links through ExternalResourceMap. AssetVersion contains no raw remote URL or managed bytes pointer.
